$comment: ArenaNet game updates whose notes were reviewed for schedule changes. Written by tools/patch-review.mjs. A review records what was read; it never verifies a schedule (see verification evidence in schedule.source.json).

reviews.title: Game Update Notes: September 15, 2026
findings: News 2026-09-08: Depths of Cruelty runs on a three-hour cycle, like the Convergences.
News 2026-09-08: the Shackles of the Ancients start moved five minutes earlier. No new time is given.
News 2026-09-08: Leyspring Hollows closes after its meta, with a prompt to move within an hour.
Notes: Hammerhart Rumble world boss event damage fix (no timing change).
newContent: Leyspring Hollows: Depths of Cruelty meta

reviews.title: Game Update Notes: September 29, 2026
findings: Notes: Depths of Cruelty bug fixes only (skill effects, Kuda's shield, a skill fact).
Notes: Challenge Mode added to the Nexus of Eternity Convergence (no timing change).
Notes: Dismount Rush bonus event (news: September 29 to October 6); no schedule effect.

reviews.title: Game Update Notes: October 13, 2026
findings: Notes: Halloween runs October 13 to November 3; news: Mad King Says every two hours (a festival event, not in the dataset).
Notes: fixed announcements showing at the wrong time during the Depths of Cruelty meta-event. This is message timing, not the schedule.
Notes: Legendary Mode for the Nexus of Eternity raid (not the Convergence schedule).
Dev tracker 2026-10-21: the wikis are down for maintenance.

reviews.title: Game Update Notes: November 10, 2026
findings: Notes: adjusted health of some bosses in the Secrets of the Weald meta-event. Balance only; no timing change stated.
Notes: Fractal Incursion event, November 10 to December 1, with open-world incursion boss events (limited-time; not in the dataset).
Notes: two Leyspring Hollows map-event fixes and three Nexus of Eternity raid fixes (no timing change; not the meta or the Convergence schedule).
Notes: Seared Borderlands WvW map beta until December 8 (not open world).
Hotfixes 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-12 (dev tracker): skill, WvW and achievement fixes; a WvW waypoint moved. No tracked event or waypoint affected.
Build 210361 is what the API reported on 2026-11-14, after the 2026-11-12 hotfix; the build of the 2026-11-10 release itself was not observed.
Read through the official feeds: the forum page itself refuses scripted requests, so player replies on the notes topic were not read.

upcoming.what: Fractal Incursion and the Extra Life bonus event end
